concepts.title: Linear Equation in One Variable
concepts.formula: linear equation in one variable: one variable, highest power = 1, e.g. 2x - 3 = 7

questions.q: Using the law a^m x a^n = a^(m+n), evaluate 5^3 x 5^2.
Using a^m / a^n = a^(m-n), evaluate 5^3 / 5^1.
Evaluate (5^3)^3 using the power of a power law.
Evaluate 2^2 x 5^2 using a^m x b^m = (ab)^m.
Find the value of 4^0.
Evaluate 8^(-3) and give the value as a fraction.

concepts.title: Solution of an Equation (LHS = RHS)
concepts.formula: solution check: LHS(a * value - b) == RHS(c) for a x - b = c

questions.q: Two triangles are congruent. In triangle one the angles are 48 and 50 degrees; the third angle is what? (The third angles must match.)

By SSS congruence, three pairs of sides must be equal. How many side equalities must be checked?
By ASA congruence, how many angle equalities plus side equalities must be checked (angles first)?
In a right triangle the hypotenuse is 5 cm and one leg is 3 cm. Find the other leg; a congruent copy has the same value.
Two isosceles triangles with vertex angle 46 degrees are congruent by SAS. Each base angle in either triangle measures what?

concepts.title: Solving Equations with the Variable on Both Sides
concepts.formula: a*x + b = c*x + d -> (a - c)*x = d - b -> x = (d - b) / (a - c)

questions.q: Evaluate 3x + 9 when x = 3.
Find the value of 6x^2 + 7x + 5 when x = 2.
Simplify 4x + 2x - 6x and give the coefficient of x.
Use the distributive law: 7 x (4 + 2) equals 7 x 4 + 7 x 2. Compute it.
Evaluate 2 + 6 x 5 (respect the order of operations).
Evaluate (8 + 4) x 9.

concepts.title: Transposing Terms
concepts.formula: a*x + b = c -> a*x = c - b

questions.q: Solve for x: 5x + 1 = 51.

concepts.title: Reducing Equations to Simpler Form
concepts.formula: multiply both sides by LCM of denominators, then transpose and divide

How many multiples of 24 are there up to 100?

concepts.title: Solving Equations with Brackets
concepts.formula: open brackets -> combine like terms -> transpose -> x = (d - b) / (a - c)
